problem_text:

Due to a legacy routing restriction, no direct fiber link exists between Node Alpha and Node Beta.  
Moreover, owing to a redundancy‑protocol requirement, exactly one of the following two cable segments must be part of the final circuit: the link between Node Beta and Node Gamma, or the link between Node Gamma and Node Delta.  

The objective is to determine the shortest possible cyclic inspection route that visits every data center exactly once and returns to the point of origin.
